objects.taxonomy_description: Stocky tailless marsupial measuring 60-85 cm in body length with robust rounded body form. Nose is broad, leathery, and black with distinctive textured surface. Limbs are powerful with five digits each; forefeet feature two opposable thumbs for gripping eucalyptus branches. Claws are sharp and curved for climbing. Body exhibits stocky proportions with broad chest and rounded abdomen. Head is broad with small eyes and inconspicuous ears relative to body size. Weight ranges 4-15 kg with sexual dimorphism. Posture is typically upright when seated on branches.

objects.taxonomy_description: 一种人造的、用于携带物品的刚性或半刚性容器，具有明确的几何结构和机械闭合装置。

diagnostic_checkpoints.整体形态: 呈现规则的长方体或立方体几何形状，具有清晰的棱角和平面，区别于生物体的有机曲线。
diagnostic_checkpoints.表面材质: 表面显示均质的人造纹理（如硬塑料、皮革或织物），缺乏生物皮肤、毛发或鳞片的自然微观结构。
diagnostic_checkpoints.机械结构: 可见非生物性的机械组件，如拉链、金属锁扣、铰链或硬质把手，这些是生物体不具备的特征。
diagnostic_checkpoints.对称性与比例: 表现出工业制造的高度几何对称性和标准化比例，不同于生物生长形成的不对称性或变异。
